meta.title: Nudge — Annotate & Tune
meta.description: Click any element in the right-sidebar browser to annotate it or live-edit its styles, text, and attributes, then hand the annotations and visual edits to the current agent.

mode.browseHint: Browse: the page keeps its native interaction. Switch to Annotate or Edit to inspect elements.
mode.annotateHint: Annotate: click an element or drag a region, then write a comment; use the sliders in the composer to adjust styles; hold Space to use the page.
mode.editHint: Edit: click an element to open the floating style card and adjust color, background, opacity, font, size, and weight live; hold Space to use the page.

dock.selectHint: Click any element on the page to begin.
dock.noPage: Enter an address to open a page

annotation.inserted: Inserted into the composer — add a note, then send.
annotation.statusDiscardArmed: Click again to discard all annotations
annotation.designDeleteHint: Remove this element and its subtree

shortcut.holdSpace: Nudge: hold Space to use the page

shortcut.hintEdit: Click an element to adjust its styles

settings.title: Nudge
settings.productIntro: Product preferences for Nudge. Changes are written to the profile cordis.patch.yml row immediately.
settings.languageHint: Follow DSH uses the host language; choosing 中文 / English only switches the Nudge UI strings.
settings.featureAnnotateHint: Hide the Annotate toggle in the toolbar; an active annotation session returns to Browse.
settings.featureEditHint: Hide the Edit toggle that opens the live style/text editing card.
settings.featureDomTreeHint: Show the DOM tree dock entry for the embedded page.
settings.featureWorkspaceVersionsHint: Show the workspace HTML / git versions / commit panel entry.
settings.featureHotReloadHint: Watch workspace files and reload the page automatically; turning this off stops polling.
settings.contextMenuLinkHint: Show "Open in Nudge" on link (and message-link) right-click menus.
settings.contextMenuTabHint: Show "Open in Nudge" in the browser tab actions menu.
settings.aboutGitUnavailable: The plugin directory is not a git repository
settings.updateUnavailable: Local link install (development build); online update check is unavailable
settings.updateHint: The local link development build does not update from the npm registry; published builds are updated by the DSH plugin manager.
settings.readOnly: This deployment does not allow writing the profile configuration from the settings page; values are shown read-only.
settings.reloadHint: If the plugin was just updated, restart the app or toggle dsh.nudge off and on again.
settings.featureFloatingComposerHint: Keep the conversation composer floating above the right panel while a Nudge tab is fullscreen.
